title: HotspotScannerConfig
description: Configuration for hotspot-scanner (.hotspot-scanner.json). Reserved meta keys ($schema, $comment, $comments) are for IDE hints only — not scan options.

$schema.description: Reserved meta: JSON Schema URI for IDE validation.

$comment.description: Reserved meta: single-line human hint (not a scan option).

$comments.description: Reserved meta: human hints (not scan options).

include.description: Additional include globs (additive to PathScope defaults).

exclude.description: Additional exclude globs (additive to PathScope defaults).

concurrency.description: Worker pool size for NCLOC analysis.
